Definition: Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess
BiblicalUsage: Noadiah = "meeting with Jehovah"; n pr m; 1) a Levite, son of Binnui, who weighed the vessels of gold and silver belonging to the temple which were brought back from Babylon; n pr f; 2) a prophetess who joined Sanballat and Tobiah in their attempt to intimidate Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
